title: Macro regime filter for XAUUSD (DXY/real yields) — position permission/sizing input
problem_statement: OHLCV-only technical features (Hyp-A, Hyp-B) show no exploitable edge on XAUUSD at H1/5-min. Test whether macro regime state (dollar strength, real yield momentum) carries information for a risk-on/risk-off filter, to be used for trade permission/sizing rather than standalone directional alpha.
target_definition: Ternary macro regime from DXY 20-session momentum: risk-on (DXY down > 0.5% over 20 sessions), neutral (|change| <= 0.5%), risk-off (DXY up > 0.5% over 20 sessions). Labeled at session close using DXY close prices; no XAUUSD price data used in label construction — pure macro regime classifier.
notes: Baseline is naive persistence (yesterday's regime = today's regime) — model must beat this, not beat zero. This is a filter/sizing input, not standalone alpha, so success bar is lower than Hyp-A/B but must still show real discriminative power over persistence. Label uses DXY only; XAUUSD used only for downstream sizing test after regime classification is validated.
